description: A learner responded to a zero-anaphora (dropped-argument) cloze probe. This is a raw signal-detection event (hit/miss/false_alarm/correct_reject): it records what was presented and how the learner responded, never a computed d' or context-debt conclusion. It is the ONLY producer of the hit (H) and false-alarm (F) rates the private backend needs for the signal-detection d' that personalizes context debt (CD_effective = CD_text x (1 - d'_norm)). Public AT Proto record (written to PDS, hits the firehose): it carries antecedent-slot metadata, an itemRef, and a contentHash reference only — the full cloze sentence surface is never stored here (see RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S5) and lives only in a server-only Tier B record via privateRecordRef. Establishes the tools.spec.learner.* public namespace for raw learner-response events (distinct from the blocked interpretation record tools.spec.learner.specScore, which stays private).

sourceId.description: Reference to the parent sentence.read event the probe was drawn from.

itemRef.description: The lemma/argument the dropped slot referred to, when resolvable.

antecedentType.description: Whether the probed slot was a dropped (zero) argument or an overt one. Signal-detection: zero trials yield hits/misses, overt(control) trials yield false-alarms/correct-rejections.

responseClass.description: Signal-detection outcome. hit/miss come from zero (signal) trials; false_alarm/correct_reject from overt (noise) trials. Aggregated into H and F for d' = z(H) - z(F).

Y.description: BKT-grade outcome: hit, correct_reject -> 1; miss, false_alarm -> 0. Lets cloze double as a knowledge signal for the host lemma.

referentialDistance.description: Clauses back to the true antecedent (RD) for the probed item, when known. Diagnostic only.

competingAntecedents.description: Number of competing antecedents in the window (PI). Diagnostic only.

sentenceContext.description: Optional copyright-safe source context. Full cloze/probe sentence surface text must NEVER appear on the public firehose (see RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S5): store the antecedent slot metadata (antecedentType, referentialDistance, competingAntecedents), the itemRef, and a contentHash reference here — never the cloze sentence surface. The full sentence lives only in a server-only Tier B record referenced by privateRecordRef.

content.description: Content-addressed reference (contentHash) to the source sentence the probe was drawn from. Replaces the removed surfaceSentence/encryptedSentence fields.

privateRecordRef.description: Optional opaque pointer to the server-only Tier B record (refType sentenceAnalysis/parseCache) that holds the full cloze sentence surface. Server-resolvable only.
